releases.name: v0.1.5 — ctrl+e
releases.body:
![The /todo dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LeonVeganMan/opencode-todo-md/master/screen/todo.png)

A project todo list for OpenCode, stored in a plain `TODO.md` and shared by every session of the project.

## Install

```json
{
  "plugins": ["opencode-todo-md"]
}
```

Restart the TUI or run `/reload` after installing: the TUI half of a plugin is loaded at process start.

## New in 0.1.5

- `ctrl+e` opens the selected task in the editor, so the whole list is reachable without the mouse.

Everything from 0.1.4 is included: the custom `/todo` dialog with state and priority tabs, tags, sorting, search, paging, per-cell clicks, the two-row editor with priority and due chips, `PgUp`/`PgDn`/`Home`/`End`, the `▸` cursor with the current row in bold and the compact sidebar strip.

![The sidebar strip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LeonVeganMan/opencode-todo-md/master/screen/sidebar.png)

## Tools

`todo_write` and `todo_read` keep the file in sync with the agent: full-list writes, or patches by stable id (`{ "id": 3, "status": "completed" }`). Priorities, due dates, creation and completion dates live in an invisible HTML comment, so the markdown stays clean and hand edits keep working.

## Notes

Installing registers the tools; nothing forces the model to use them. One line in `AGENTS.md` makes the file the source of truth:

```markdown
If the project has a TODO.md at the root, keep it updated with todo_write (run todo_read first, then send the whole list).
```

49 unit tests. MIT.

releases.name: v0.1.4 — keyboard paging
releases.body:
A todo list for OpenCode that lives in your repository: the agent, the sidebar and every session of the project read and write the same `TODO.md`.

![The /todo dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LeonVeganMan/opencode-todo-md/master/screen/todo.png)

![The sidebar strip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LeonVeganMan/opencode-todo-md/master/screen/sidebar.png)

## Install

```json
{ "plugins": ["opencode-todo-md"] }
```

Restart the TUI (or run `/reload`) so the TUI half loads.

## New in 0.1.4

- `PgUp`/`PgDn` change page, `Home`/`End` jump to the first or last page.
- `↑`/`↓` turn the page when the cursor walks past the last visible row.
- The current row is marked with `▸` and shown in bold.

## Highlights

- `todo_write` / `todo_read` tools with stable ids: the agent replaces the whole list or patches single items.
- `/todo` dialog: state and priority tabs with counters, tag filter, five sort orders, search, paging, per-cell clicks.
- Double `ctrl+d` deletes a task without a confirmation dialog.
- Priorities, due dates, creation and completion dates, `@tags` derived from the text.
- Checkboxes are rewritten in place; headings and notes in `TODO.md` are never touched.

49 unit tests. MIT.

releases.name: v0.1.2 — /todo dialog, import, help
releases.body:
A todo list for OpenCode that lives in your repository: the agent, the sidebar and every session of the project read and
write the same `TODO.md`.

Session-scoped lists disappear with the session and lose their state on compaction. This one is plain markdown next to
the code: it survives restarts, shows up in `git diff`, and can be edited by hand without breaking the metadata.

![The /todo dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LeonVeganMan/opencode-todo-md/v0.1.2/screen/todo.png)

## Install

```json
{ "plugins": ["opencode-todo-md"] }
```

## What you get

- `todo_write` / `todo_read` tools: the agent replaces the whole list or patches single items by id.
- `/todo`: a self-drawn dialog with filter tabs and counters, tag and priority filters, sortable columns, search,
  paging and per-cell clicks.
- `/todo add <text> [high|medium|low] [due=YYYY-MM-DD]`, `/todo done <id>`, `/todo init`, `/todo import`, `/todo help`.
- A sidebar strip that turns red when a task is overdue.

![The sidebar strip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LeonVeganMan/opencode-todo-md/v0.1.2/screen/sidebar.png)

```markdown
- [ ] Fix login redirect <!-- id=1 priority=high due=2026-11-05 created=2026-10-30 -->
- [x] Add screenshot <!-- id=3 done=2026-10-31 created=2026-10-28 -->
```

The checklist is rewritten in place, so headings and notes in the file survive untouched, and priority/dates live in an
invisible HTML comment so the markdown renders cleanly on GitHub.

## New in 0.1.2

- The `/todo` dialog is drawn by the plugin instead of the host select: filters stay on one line and the list never
  closes and reopens.
- Stable ids, due dates, creation and completion dates, `@tags` derived from the task text.
- `/todo import` adopts a hand-written list of bullets or numbered items after a preview.
- `/todo help` documents the subcommands, which are arguments of `/todo` and therefore hidden from the palette.
- TUI dependencies (`@opentui/core`, `@opentui/solid`, `solid-js`) are bundled, so the strip and the dialog load from
  npm too.

## Notes

Installing registers the tools, but nothing forces the model to use them. One line in `AGENTS.md` makes the file the
source of truth:

```markdown
If the project has a TODO.md at the root, keep it updated with todo_write (run todo_read first, then send the whole
list). Do not edit the checkboxes by hand: the metadata lives in the trailing HTML comment.
```

47 unit tests, no build step. The TUI half loads at startup: restart OpenCode (or `/reload`) after installing or
updating.

releases.name: v0.1.0 — project todo list on TODO.md
releases.body:
Todo list for OpenCode stored in a plain `TODO.md` at the project root, shared by every session.

## Install

```json
{ "plugins": ["opencode-todo-md"] }
```

or clone the repo into `~/.opencode/plugins/opencode-todo-md` for local development.

## What you get

- `todo_write` / `todo_read` for the agent, with stable ids and patch mode
- sidebar strip with priority colours and an overdue marker
- `/todo` dialog: filter tabs with counters, priority and tag filters, sortable columns, search, paging, per-cell clicks
- `/todo add`, `/todo done <id>`, `/todo init`
- checklist rewritten in place; ids, priority and dates in an invisible HTML comment
- 41 unit tests (`bun test`)

Docs: https://github.com/LeonVeganMan/opencode-todo-md#readme
